issue.title: [Bug]: SMF abort on PFCP Session Report Request when Report Type DLDR=1 but Downlink Data Report IE is missing

labels.name: Housekeeping:ToClose
labels.description: Issues reviewed and closed. Old requests, issues which are not bug, feature or documentation request

repository.name: open5gs
repository.description: Open5GS is a C-language Open Source implementation for 5G Core and EPC, i.e. the core network of LTE/NR network (Release-19)

license.name: GNU Affero General Public License v3.0

issue.body:
### Open5GS Release, Revision, or Tag

v2.8.0

### Steps to reproduce

1. Bring up Open5GS 5GC. Associate SMF and UPF on PFCP (`:8805`).
2. Establish a real PDU session (UE + gNB simulator is enough; UERANSIM in our lab).
3. Note the **CP F-SEID** from the PFCP Session Establishment Request (IE 57). The Session Report header SEID must be this CP-SEID, not the UP-SEID.
4. From the **already-associated UPF address and UDP port 8805**, send one PFCP Session Report Request:

   | Field | Value |
   |---|---|
   | Message type | 56 (Session Report Request) |
   | Header SEID | CP F-SEID of the live session |
   | Report Type (IE 39) | `0x01` (DLDR=1 only) |
   | Downlink Data Report (IE 83) | **absent** |

5. Open5GS looks up the PFCP node by `srcIP:srcPort`. If the packet does not come from the associated UPF `:8805`, SMF logs `Cannot find PFCP-Node` / `No Session` and does **not** crash. The crash needs a live session **and** a spoofed/associated UPF source.

Same abort also happens for other Session Report causes that are not `REQUEST_ACCEPTED` (empty Report Type; Report Type `0xFF` with the DLDR bit still set). Those are the same FSM bug, not a second defect.


### Logs

```shell

```

### Expected behaviour

If Report Type has DLDR=1 but the Downlink Data Report IE is missing, SMF should answer Session Report Response with a PFCP cause (Mandatory IE missing / Conditional IE missing / Session context not found) and **keep running**. A non-accepted report must not start a PDU-session deletion with `trigger == 0`.


### Observed Behaviour

`smf_n4_handle_session_report_request()` correctly logs `No Downlink Data Report` and returns `SESSION_CONTEXT_NOT_FOUND`. Then `gsm-sm.c` treats any cause other than `REQUEST_ACCEPTED` as “go delete the session”:

```c
/* src/smf/gsm-sm.c */
case OGS_PFCP_SESSION_REPORT_REQUEST_TYPE:
    pfcp_cause = smf_n4_handle_session_report_request(...);
    if (pfcp_cause != OGS_PFCP_CAUSE_REQUEST_ACCEPTED) {
        OGS_FSM_TRAN(s, smf_gsm_state_wait_pfcp_deletion);
    }
```

`smf_gsm_state_wait_pfcp_deletion` ENTRY calls `smf_5gc_pfcp_send_session_deletion_request(sess, stream, e->h.sbi.state)`. The event is PFCP, not SBI, so `e->h.sbi.state == 0`, and `ogs_assert(trigger)` in `src/smf/pfcp-path.c` aborts the SMF.

This is not issue #1635 (`assert(sess)` when the session is missing) and not #1034 (old “Invalid Downlink Data Service Information” path). The session **is** found; the abort is the deletion-state trigger.

Related shape in another implementation: free5GC #805 / CVE-2026-25501 (nil deref on the same missing IE). Different code, different crash.


### eNodeB/gNodeB

UERANSIM

### UE Models and versions

UERANSIM

issue.title: [Bug]: SMF SIGSEGV on PFCP Session Report Request when Report Type has ERIR+USAR but Error Indication Report IE is missing

labels.name: status:already-fixed
labels.description: This issue has already been fixed in the codebase or addressed in a previous issue.

repository.name: open5gs
repository.description: Open5GS is a C-language Open Source implementation for 5G Core and EPC, i.e. the core network of LTE/NR network (Release-19)

license.name: GNU Affero General Public License v3.0

issue.body:
### Open5GS Release, Revision, or Tag

v2.8.0

### Steps to reproduce

1. Same setup as a normal 5GC PDU session: SMF–UPF associated, one live PDU session.
2. Header SEID = **CP F-SEID**. Source = associated UPF `IP:8805`.
3. Send PFCP Session Report Request:

   | Field | Value |
   |---|---|
   | Message type | 56 |
   | Header SEID | CP F-SEID |
   | Report Type (IE 39) | `0x06` (USAR + ERIR) |
   | Usage Report (IE 80) | present: URR-ID + UR-SEQN (no Usage Report Trigger, no Volume Measurement) |
   | Error Indication Report (IE 99) | **absent** |
   | Downlink Data Report | optional; not required |

4. Controls that do **not** crash on this image:
   - Report Type `0x04` (ERIR only), no IEs → log only
   - Report Type `0x06` with **no** Usage Report grouped IE → log `Cannot find Session in Error Indication`, process stays up

The crash needs **ERIR set and a Usage Report that reaches the volume-measurement parser**.

### Logs

```shell

```

### Expected behaviour

If ERIR=1 and the Error Indication Report IE is missing or does not match a FAR, SMF should return a PFCP cause and continue. It must not keep parsing a Usage Report whose Volume Measurement pointer is NULL.


### Observed Behaviour

`report_type.error_indication_report` is set. `ogs_pfcp_far_find_by_pfcp_session_report()` fails, SMF logs `Cannot find Session in Error Indication`, and **does not return**. The function then enters the Usage Report loop (`n4-handler.c` around 1728). When the Usage Report has a matching URR-ID, it calls:

```c
decoded = ogs_pfcp_parse_volume_measurement(
        &volume, &use_rep->volume_measurement);
```

`ogs_pfcp_parse_volume_measurement()` (`lib/pfcp/types.c`) does not check `octet->data`. If Volume Measurement is absent, `octet->data` is NULL and line

```c
volume->flags = ((unsigned char *)octet->data)[size];
```

is a SIGSEGV.

This is a different **use case** from a Session Report that only sets USAR (no ERIR bit, no 1725 log). Please keep that as a separate issue. Fixing only the Error Indication lookup will not cover a USAR-only report that hits the same parser.

Not #1635 (`assert(sess)`). Not #1034.

### eNodeB/gNodeB

UERANSIM

### UE Models and versions

UERANSIM
